# Antigravity CLI 1.3.1 catalogue identity

Research record: [378](../../../../../docs/research/378-antigravity-cli-1-3-1-catalogue-identity.md).

identity.json freezes the official channel, exact source commits, full published
asset manifest for every newly published stable, and verified Linux x64 / Mac
ARM64 runtime digests. dist-inventory.json records every member of each
downloaded archive. protocol.json classifies every hop's exact source path
set and changed runtime files against the selected agy models behavior.

Only antigravity.catalogue is in scope. The exact unpublished 1.2.18 point
stays excluded. The headless ceiling and its unqualified gaps are unchanged.
No downloaded binary was executed; no provider prompt, live catalogue,
credential, install, or host update was used.
